customer_profile.name: Fortigi Maatschap
customer_profile.description: Fortigi is a Dutch Identity and Access Management (IAM) security maatschap that provides specialized IAM consultancy services. They help organizations design, implement, and optimize identity and access management solutions, focusing on identity governance, privileged access management, and access control frameworks.

regulations.name: General Data Protection Regulation
regulations.relevance: IAM implementations must ensure proper data protection and privacy controls for personal identity data

regulations.name: Network and Information Systems Directive 2
regulations.relevance: Helps clients implement identity security controls required for NIS2 compliance

regulations.name: Digital Operational Resilience Act
regulations.relevance: Provides IAM consulting to financial sector clients who must meet DORA identity and access requirements

regulations.name: ISO 27001 Information Security Management
regulations.relevance: IAM implementations must align with ISO 27001 access control and identity management requirements

critical_business_processes: Identity governance program design and implementation
IAM solution selection and vendor evaluation

known_systems.name: Client IAM Platforms
known_systems.description: Various IAM platforms that consultants work with at client sites including SailPoint, CyberArk, Okta, Azure AD

known_systems.name: Consulting Management Platform
known_systems.description: Platform for managing consulting engagements, project deliverables, and client relationships

known_systems.name: Knowledge Management System
known_systems.description: Repository of IAM frameworks, methodologies, and best practices used across consulting engagements

critical_roles.rationale: Partners in the maatschap with ultimate responsibility for business operations and client relationships
Senior consultants responsible for designing IAM architectures and strategies for clients
Core consultants delivering IAM implementations and advisory services to clients
Specialists in privileged access management implementations and security
Specialists in identity governance and administration solutions
Responsible for acquiring new consulting engagements and maintaining client relationships

risk_domains.description: Risks from loss or unauthorized access to entrusted customer records, design documents, and confidential project materials
High-risk exposure of any PII data that may inadvertently be collected or stored during consulting engagements
Risks to specialized IAM knowledge and consulting capabilities that drive business value
Risks of non-compliance with data protection and security regulations affecting IAM implementations
Risks from consultants with deep access to client IAM systems and sensitive identity data
Risks to ongoing consulting relationships and project delivery capabilities
Risks to proprietary IAM methodologies, frameworks, and consulting approaches
